description: Turn an image into custom die-cut vinyl stickers printed by Bottle Your Brand. Use this whenever someone wants stickers made from a picture, logo, drawing, or artwork — for example 'make this into stickers', 'print my logo as stickers', or 'I want die-cut stickers of this'. Takes a public https URL to the image (PNG, JPG, or PDF) and returns a link that opens the Bottle Your Brand order page with the artwork already attached, so the customer only has to pick a size. Show the returned link to the customer as a clickable link.

image_url.description: Public https URL of the image to print. PNG, JPG, or PDF.

name: order_custom_stickers

expires_at.description: ISO timestamp after which the link stops working.

file_name.description: Name the artwork will carry on the order.

order_url.description: Link that opens the order page with the artwork attached.

product.description: Product key the order link is for.

title: Order custom stickers
